senses.definition: To flirt with; to approach and speak to (someone), seeking romance, love, sex, etc.
senses.example: That's the third guy that has hit on her tonight.

senses.definition: To discover, pinpoint; to think up; to realize.
senses.example: He hit on a great idea for improving the design.

senses.definition: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see hit, on.
senses.example: He was hit on his head so strongly that he stumbled forward and then he was severely hit from several sides.
